policy.rule: Raw page, article-number, DOI, repository, address and database-ID occurrences are collision observations and have zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: No target in this append is promoted to a new physical P1/P2; a physical-value promotion requires an independently verified quantity and declared unit/tolerance.
policy.namespace_control: Article pages, article numbers, DOI suffixes, repository handles, postal codes and database IDs are counted separately before independence or collision density is assessed.

information_updates.finding: The SrRuO3-PrMnO3 and FeGe papers form a useful magnetic-materials reference cluster for anisotropic coupling, magnetoresistance and itinerant/local-spin competition.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 44190 is respectively a page number and DOI component, not a measured magnetic quantity.

information_updates.finding: The polyimide/carbon-nanofiber paper links electrical percolation, dielectric response and electromagnetic-shielding effectiveness and is directly relevant to Worldshepherd conductive/shielding composite screening.
The ZnFe2O4 work combines quantum-mechanical vibrational modeling with Raman-mode/phase-transition analysis and is useful as a solver-to-spectroscopy reconciliation reference.

The self-charging granular study and optical microring-sensing study provide separate Worldshepherd references for triboelectric/electrostatic emergent charging and high-Q optical sensing, respectively.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 39996 is an article number/page in these sources, not the physical observable.

information_updates.finding: No new physical-value P1 was established in this batch despite targeted cm^-1 searches; the batch therefore strengthens the raw collision/null corpus rather than the physical-evidence ledger.
